stemMd: Which conclusion is best supported by the garden's recordkeeping?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Parent counts alone prove that every original variant survives.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Fresh seeds are always less viable than old seeds.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Evaluating the collection requires information about both viability and renewal practices.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Germination rates reveal the exact genetic sequence of each seed.

options.label: E
options.textMd: All batches must be renewed simultaneously.

explanationMd: The two recorded quantities respond to two different concerns: whether seeds can germinate and how replacement batches were produced. Neither alone provides the complete evaluation described.

distractorRationale.e: Renewal depends on batch-specific test results.
distractorRationale.a: The text gives no such guarantee.
distractorRationale.d: Viability does not supply sequence information.
